chunks.text: The Nest is the always-on community for all members of the Nest ecosystem — alumni, current participants, and anyone who wants to stay connected. It is not a program with a start and end date. It is a living community that runs year-round. The Nest includes alumni circles, peer support groups, job board, community events, workshops, and networking opportunities. It is the home base for women who have completed a program and want to stay engaged, and for women who are not ready for a program yet but want to explore.

The Nest is the right recommendation for women who are not sure what they want yet, are still exploring, are not ready to commit to a 12-week program, or just want to be part of a supportive community of women in tech. It keeps the door open warmly without pressure. Nesta can say: 'You don't have to decide anything today. The Nest community is always here — you can join workshops, meet other women on similar journeys, and explore at your own pace.'
